sloka: हतो ऽस्मि यदि मामेवं भगवानपि मन्यते ।मत्तो न दोषमाशङ्के नैवं मामनुशाधि हि ॥ २.९०.१५
transliteration: hato 'smi yadi māmevaṁ bhagavānapi manyate ।matto na doṣamāśaṅke naivaṁ māmanuśādhi hi ॥ 2.90.15

translations.english: When one so venerable like you too misunderstands me, I am gone. There is no danger for him from me. Do not rebuke me this way.
